metadata.title: Join Ninja Labs | Ninja Labs
metadata.description: Apply to join the next Ninja Labs cohort: see how the community works and send your application.

hero.heading: Build with Ninja Labs
hero.description: Read how the community works, then apply for the open cohort. You need a Ninja Labs account with a finished sign-up.

banner.label: Member recruitment
banner.title: {name} is recruiting members
banner.body: Applications are open. Tell us who you are and what you want to work on.

cohort.periodOpen: Applications are open until the cohort is closed.

failed.title: We couldn’t load this right now.
failed.body: We couldn’t reach the server. Please try again shortly.

noCohort.title: No cohort is recruiting right now.
noCohort.body: The next cohort will be announced in the notices.

signIn.title: Sign in to apply
signIn.body: Sign in with Google and finish the quick sign-up. You will come back to this page afterwards.

title.open: Applications are not open right now.

notAccepting.body: Watch the notices for the next call.

onboarding.title: Finish signing up first
onboarding.body: Applications need a finished sign-up. Complete the remaining step and we will bring you back here.

form.title: Tell us about yourself

intro.label: Introduction and motivation*
intro.placeholder: Who are you, what have you built or written, and why Ninja Labs?

form.reapplyIntro: You withdrew your earlier application. Send a new one while the cohort is recruiting.

saved.submitted: Your application was sent. We will review it and update the status here.

telegram.label: Telegram ID*
telegram.hint: 5-32 letters, digits or _. A t.me link works too.

twitter.label: Twitter (X) ID*
twitter.hint: 1-15 letters, digits or _. An x.com link works too.

activityType.label: What best describes your current activity?*

errors.invalid: The server rejected this value. Check it and try again.
errors.telegramInvalid: Use 5-32 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.

saveErrors.network: We couldn’t send your application. Check your connection and try again.
saveErrors.session: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
saveErrors.invalid: Check every field and try again.
saveErrors.generic: We couldn’t save your application. Please try again.
saveErrors.PROFILE_REQUIRED: Finish your sign-up (profile step) before applying.
saveErrors.COHORT_NOT_FOUND: This cohort is no longer available.
saveErrors.COHORT_NOT_ACCEPTING: This cohort is not accepting applications right now.
saveErrors.COHORT_ALREADY_APPLIED: You already applied to this cohort. We refreshed the page.
saveErrors.COHORT_APPLICATION_NOT_SUBMITTED: This application was already reviewed or withdrawn, so it can’t be edited.
saveErrors.INVALID_CHARACTER: A field contains characters that cannot be saved. Remove them and try again.
saveErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
saveErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

SUBMITTED.label: Under review
SUBMITTED.description: We received your application. The operators will review it.

ACCEPTED.label: Accepted
ACCEPTED.description: Congratulations, your application was accepted. The operators will contact you about joining as a member.

REJECTED.label: Not selected
REJECTED.description: Your application was not selected this time. Thank you for applying, and please try again in a later cohort.

mine.editClosed: Recruitment has ended, so the application can no longer be edited. You can still withdraw it.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw your application to {name}?
withdrawDialog.description: The operators will no longer review it. While the cohort is recruiting you can apply again.
withdrawDialog.callout: Your answers are kept for the operators’ records.

withdrawErrors.COHORT_APPLICATION_NOT_SUBMITTED: This application was already reviewed or withdrawn.
withdrawErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
withdrawErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
withdrawErrors.generic: We couldn’t withdraw this application. Please try again shortly.

account.heading: Cohort applications
account.empty: You have not applied to a cohort yet.
